newsitem.title: USA: Adept sees Q1 earnings below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Adept sees Q1 earnings below estimates.

text.p: Adept Technology Inc said Friday it expects first quarter earnings per share to be "significantly lower than analysts' expectations."
The company said it expects the first quarter to be profitable, with revenues of $17.8-$18.8 million.
The company attributed the adjusted estimates for its first quarter, ending September 28, to slowing demand in Europe and other international markets.
The automation software company said a slowdown in international markets has delayed orders, which "will likely impact Adept's revenues and earnings through the end of the calendar year."
The company said it is cutting expenses and will begin producing several new products in the second half of the fiscal year.

First Call estimates were unavailable. The company reported a fourth quarter profit of $0.16 per share compared with a $0.33 share loss in the year-ago period. It reported fourth quarter revenues of almost $20.4 million.
